description: This is a single armchair upholstered in a textured, medium blue fabric. The chair features a high, winged backrest with a button-tufted design arranged in a 3x3 grid. It has wide, supportive arms and a deep, comfortable seat. The chair is supported by four slender, tapered wooden legs that angle outwards slightly. The overall design suggests a blend of mid-century modern and contemporary aesthetics, offering both comfort and style for a living space.
